description: The full conversion of utopia-php/database 7.4: Database (collections, attributes, indexes, documents, bulk operations, upserts, increments, relationships, permissions, tenancy, caching, transactions), Document, Query, Operator, DateTime, the helpers and validators, over every adapter: PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MySQL, SQLite, the in-memory one, MongoDB, Redis, Pool and Mirror (with its Mirroring filters), and the shared Redis caches.

waivers.Utopia\\Database\\PDO::*: PHP runtime plumbing: a PDO wrapper that reconnects; the Rust adapter owns its PostgreSQL connection (the wire protocol, adapter::postgres::wire) (reconnect behaviour is converted with Adapter::reconnect)
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\PDOStatement::*: PHP runtime plumbing: the PDOStatement wrapper of Utopia\Database\PDO

bound.create_document: One INSERT (document and permissions) on PostgreSQL: the round trip, the same server and network for both runtimes, dominates the call
bound.create_documents: One batched INSERT of ten documents on PostgreSQL: the round trip dominates the call
bound.get_document: One SELECT on PostgreSQL (uncached): the round trip dominates the call
bound.find: One SELECT over 100 rows on PostgreSQL: the round trip and the server's query dominate the call
bound.update_document: A transaction with a locking read and an UPDATE on PostgreSQL: its round trips dominate the call
bound.cached_get_document: One HGET on Redis and the decode of a small document: the round trip, the same server and network for both runtimes, dominates the call
bound.redis_get_document: A MULTI of the document and its permissions on Redis: the round trip dominates the call
bound.create_document_mariadb: One INSERT of the document and one of its permissions on MariaDB: the round trips dominate the call
bound.create_documents_mariadb: One batched INSERT of ten documents (and one of their permissions) on MariaDB: the round trips dominate the call
bound.get_document_mariadb: One SELECT on MariaDB (uncached): the round trip dominates the call
bound.find_mariadb: One SELECT over 100 rows on MariaDB: the round trip and the server's query dominate the call
bound.update_document_mariadb: A transaction with a locking read and an UPDATE on MariaDB: its round trips dominate the call
bound.create_document_mysql: One INSERT of the document and one of its permissions on MySQL: the round trips dominate the call
bound.create_documents_mysql: One batched INSERT of ten documents (and one of their permissions) on MySQL: the round trips dominate the call
bound.get_document_mysql: One SELECT on MySQL (uncached): the round trip dominates the call
bound.find_mysql: One SELECT over 100 rows on MySQL: the round trip and the server's query dominate the call
bound.update_document_mysql: A transaction with a locking read and an UPDATE on MySQL: its round trips dominate the call
bound.mongo_create_document: One insert command on MongoDB: the round trip, the same server and network for both runtimes, dominates the call
bound.mongo_get_document: One find command on MongoDB (uncached): the round trip dominates the call
bound.mongo_find: One find command over 100 documents on MongoDB: the round trip and the server's query dominate the call
bound.mongo_update_document: A find and an update command on MongoDB: their round trips dominate the call
